articles.description: The International Energy Agency said on Thursday that the Middle East crisis triggered by US and Israeli strikes on Iran in February posed the “largest threat” to energy security in history. It warned that consumers were bearing more of the costs as Iran’s blockade of the Strait of Hormuz disrupted oil shipments.

articles.title: FIFA rankings: France finish the year on the podium, Morocco break into the top five
articles.description: FIFA unveiled its final world ranking of 2026. France remain third in the world, behind Spain and Argentina. Les Bleus have now finished in the top three for the ninth consecutive year. Morocco climb two places to fifth, equalling the best-ever ranking by an African nation, previously achieved by Nigeria in 1994. Brazil drop to seventh, while Senegal remain 18th and Ivory Coast sit 28th.

articles.title: Des membres du personnel de l'Education nationale sont-ils complices des violences commises en marge des mobilisations lycéennes, comme l'affirme le gouvernement ?

Or, les quelques cas signalés par les autorités judiciaires n'ont aucun lien avec la fourniture de mortiers d'artifice à des élèves et concernent des enseignants qui ne sont plus en exercice ou ont agi hors du cadre du lycée.

articles.title: «Il y a un vrai traumatisme» : un mois après les violences du 17 octobre, les commerçants parisiens tentent de se reconstruire
